target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
make 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|warning" | head; echo built
./collatz_tests shadow-search --octave-min 20 --seeds-per-octave 20000 --moduli 9,27,81 --tilts 0,1 --char-cap 3 --delta 0.1 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "--- now: shadow-bearing fraction by label (null-corrected) ---"
awk -F, '!/^#/ && NF>=14 && $1!="window_id" {n[$5]++; if($14==1)s[$5]++}
  END{ printf "%-22s %8s %12s\n","label","nwin","frac_shadow"; for(l in n) printf "%-22s %8d %12.4f\n",l,n[l],s[l]/n[l] }' out/shadow_search.csv
echo "--- shadow rate vs length: does excess persist into long windows? ---"
awk -F, '!/^#/ && NF>=14 && $1!="window_id" {L=$4; band=(L<16)?"08-15":(L<32)?"16-31":(L<64)?"32-63":"64+"; n[band]++; if($14==1)s[band]++}
  END{for(b in n) printf "len %-6s n=%-7d frac_shadow=%.4f\n",b,n[b],s[b]/n[b]}' out/shadow_search.csv | sort
